summary: The session's finalized state is enforced by only some mutating entry points
evidence: register_local_alias and register_call reject a finalized session, but observe_literal, notify_stored_literal, notify_stored_root, notify_rejected_root, fresh_owner, register_local_expr, and register_expr_call remain callable after finalize. Several mutate literal state, owner allocation, cells, constraints, or target/reason seeds after the sole solve. Current main and flat orchestration obey finalize-last, so this is not a demonstrated current acceptance-criteria violation; the risk is that future stage-3 integration can silently create stale closure results instead of failing at the ownership boundary. The round-two opaque-alias correction does not alter this lifecycle boundary.
fix: Centralize an ensure_open guard and invoke it from every mutator and owner allocator, or split collection and finalized-query states into distinct abstract types so post-finalization mutation is unrepresentable.

summary: Semantic unknown-reason kinds are represented as unrestricted strings and mapped with a catch-all
evidence: Both target identities and semantic reason kinds use the same String_set representation. Producers seed string literals such as callback_param and dropped_node, while arch_index_cmt.ml maps only dropped_node explicitly and silently converts every other value, including a typo or future stage-3 reason, to Callback_param. The validated contract defines reasons as independent semantic kinds and specifies a closed persistence mapping. The round-two correction legitimately reuses callback_param but does not make this mapping exhaustive.
fix: Give reasons a private variant and dedicated ordered set, then expose an exhaustive conversion to existing top_reason values at the integration boundary. Keep targets as strings if canonical stored names remain their intended identity.

summary: Root and same-callable expression transfer duplicate the stage-2 expression grammar
evidence: root_expr_cell and expr_cell/build independently encode Pident copying, if/match joins, sequence-result selection, function literals, and opaque fallback. Their ownership and literal-authentication policies differ legitimately, but their syntax dispatch is duplicated inside the private CMT module. A stage-3 addition to returned values, arguments, or captures would require coordinated edits in both walkers and could create root/local semantic drift. The round-two root-alias correction is intentionally narrow and neither resolves nor materially worsens this duplication.
fix: Extract one internal expression-transfer walker parameterized by source-ownership lookup and literal-cell policy, preserving deliberate root-versus-callable policy in those callbacks.
